name: 红绒十字
evolution: 治愈兔 → 红丝绒 Lv.16 → 红绒十字 Lv.36
description: 头顶的十字结构能释放出强效的治愈魔法，轻轻一碰就能缓解肌肉酸痛，伤口也会加速愈合。如果看到受伤的精灵但无法施救的话会流泪不止。
descriptionEn: The cross structure on its head can release powerful healing magic; a light touch relieves muscle soreness and accelerates wound healing. If it sees a wounded spirit it cannot help, it weeps endlessly.
